## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-5: Aggregate reduction across 5 sites >=70%, harness emits JSON report with per-site, aggregate %, both HEAD SHAs, tokenizer name

## Description
Compute per-site and aggregate % reduction from task-3 records. Gating: exit 0 with `status: pass` at >=70%; exit 0 with `status: partial` at 50-70%; exit non-zero with `status: fail` <50%. Emit JSON to `output_path`: `per_site` array (site_id, pre_tokens, post_tokens, reduction_pct), `aggregate_reduction_pct`, `pre_head_sha`, `post_head_sha`, `tokenizer_name`, `status`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh exits 0
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] JSON report has all required fields
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-measure-token-reduction.sh
- [ ] >=70% → status=pass, exit 0
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-measure-token-reduction.sh
- [ ] <50% → status=fail, non-zero exit
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-measure-token-reduction.sh
- [ ] 50-70% → status=partial
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-measure-token-reduction.sh

## File Impact
| Path | Action |
|---|---|
| plugins/dso/scripts/scratch-measure-token-reduction.py | Edit |
| tests/scratch/test-measure-token-reduction.sh | Edit |

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 sonnet → opus → user.
data.title: Compute aggregate reduction, gate at 70%, emit JSON report
